principle_violations.reason: The 'Order' class manages order items and also tracks its payment status, violating SRP. Additionally, details about payment processing are hardcoded into the processor classes instead of abstracting the responsibility.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor 'Order' to separate items management and state tracking. Additionally, make payment processing more generic and adhere to dependency injection principles.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details above.
